Ministry Of Rural Development
Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
Below Poverty Line - BPL Pension Widow
Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is implemented by
Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. It is a non-contributory
pension scheme to provide social security to widows of poor family (BPL) of the
society.
A pension of Rs.300/- per month is provided to Widows between 40 years and 79
years. For persons who are 80 years and above the pension is Rs.500/- per month.

Feedback The eligibility criteria under Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
(IGNWPS) is:-
The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years.
The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line
according to the criteria prescribed by the Govt. of India
Pension will be discontinued
In case of remarriage of widow
Once the widow moves above poverty line
10/2/26, 3:12 PM Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
https://www.myscheme.gov.in/schemes/ignwps 2/5
Apply Now
Documents Required
One can download UMANG App or visit website
https://web.umang.gov.in/web_new/home
The citizen can login using mobile number and OTP.
Once logged In, citizen can search for NSAP.
Click on “Apply Online”
Fill the basic details, choose the mode of payment of pension, upload photo
and click on “Submit”.
Death Certificate of husband – With the name of the surviving wife(widow).
BPL Card.
Age Proof - For age, the birth certificate or school certificate may be relied on. In
their absence ration card and EPIC may be considered. If there is no valid
document, any Medical Officer of any government hospital may be authorized to
issue the age certificate.
